author: w0001111
release_changes: Order sessions by recent user message or final reply without opening desktop tasks.
Refresh the first eight visible task states with bounded concurrency.
Preview explicit local result images and retry or refresh artifact discovery.
Restore tab-local drafts, disclosure state and reading position; clear on logout.
Allow manual continuation after a confirmed failed or interrupted terminal turn, preserving approval guards.
Retain portable paths, configurable Codex home, multi-platform pairing, attribution and intentional public contact information.

browser_qa.data: synthetic API fixtures only; no production or model calls
checks: timeline newest first and reading position restored
image retry and fresh artifact request
failed terminal task manual send once; model switch blocked
new session isolated from old draft

checks.screenshot_visual_review: All four synthetic screenshots inspected; blank credentials, fictional tasks and login records; no actual user data. This is visual inspection, not OCR.

historical_validation.scope: The existing pinned cc-connect adapter and deployment scripts are unchanged. Earlier fresh-install/build and upstream package results are historical and were not rerun for rc.8.
upstream_test_observations: The first all-package Go run failed in two asynchronous model/cache tests and one release_local engine temporary-directory cleanup test; it is not reported as a clean full-suite pass.
Both model/cache tests passed when rerun in isolation on both unchanged upstream and the candidate.
The release_local engine cleanup failure also reproduced on unchanged upstream.
A combined CUJ run later hit an image-test temporary-directory cleanup failure; the separate CUJ run passed. No tests were removed or weakened to hide these results.

limitations: Real-account round trips have not been exercised for every messaging platform.
Each operator must create their own bot, obtain platform permissions, and verify their own HTTPS/DNS/SSH relay.
Cloud relay provisioning and macOS login services were prepared but not executed against the original installation.
Codex desktop internal IPC compatibility must be rechecked after desktop upgrades.
This is single-owner self-hosting, not public multi-tenant registration.
ChatGPT original-chat integration is not implemented.
Release signature establishes key provenance, not legal identity, originality, vulnerability-free code or live-server verification.
private_data_excluded: certificates, SSH authentication keys and release signing private keys
